prompt: Subject: Eyes Closed in Sunlight Main Subject: A vertical close-up of a woman on a white bed, tilting her face up with eyes closed in the morning sun. Focuses on the face, neck, and white lace chest area. Person & Expression: Chin raised, eyes closed, lips slightly parted. Long eyelashes and long brown hair flowing back. Clothing & Pose: A white camisole dress with thin straps and delicate lace trim. Leaning back to emphasize the line from face to neck. Background & Lighting: Hard direct sunlight from a window in the upper right. White plush bedding, warm lamp in background. Strong shadows and bright highlights. Composition & Camera: 3:4 vertical composition, extreme close-up from chest to top of head, background heavily blurred. Texture & Style: High-definition beauty photography highlighting skin glow and lace textures. Negative: Do not open eyes; do not make the upward angle of the face shallow.

promptZh: 主体：阳光下闭眼 主要主体：一位女性在 白色床铺 上的竖构图特写，她仰起脸，在清晨的阳光下闭着双眼。聚焦于面部、颈部和白色蕾丝胸部区域。人物与表情：下巴抬起，双眼紧闭，双唇微张。长长的睫毛，棕色长发向后飘散。服装与姿势：穿着 带有细肩带和精致蕾丝饰边的白色吊带裙。身体后倾，以强调从面部到颈部的线条。背景与光影：来自右上角窗户的强烈直射阳光。白色毛绒床品，背景中有暖色调灯光。强烈的阴影和明亮的高光。构图与摄影：3:4 竖构图，从胸部到头顶的极致特写，背景高度模糊。质感与风格：高清美妆摄影，突出皮肤光泽和蕾丝质感。负面提示：不要睁眼；不要让面部的仰角过小。
